description: Formal health-reference ownership of no-active-disease background modifier families. The runtime still reads detailed numeric modifiers from background_modifiers.json during migration.

modifier_modules.meaning: Changes no-active-disease reference ranges and base prevalence.
Changes WBC, hemoglobin, creatinine, D-dimer, fibrinogen, and vital baselines before active disease is considered.
Changes renal, hematology, and biomarker base measures.
Changes albumin, INR, platelet count, bilirubin, and infection-risk base measures.
Changes glucose and infection/source-risk base measures.
Changes WBC/ANC, fever, CRP, PCT, and infection base measures without itself selecting a disease manifold.
Changes expected no-active-disease measurements and modifies response reserve.
Changes reference distributions before active disease likelihood is scored.
